newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Officer, aide killed in Philippine rebel ambush.
newsitem.headline: Officer, aide killed in Philippine rebel ambush.

text.p: Suspected communist rebels on Wednesday shot dead a Philippine police commander and an escort in an ambush in central Camarines Norte province, police said.
One other policeman was wounded when the attackers fired on a jeep carrying Major Roberto Rosales while the officers were on an inspection trip in Paracale municipality, a police report said.
The government estimates the current strength of the rebel Marxist New People's Army (NPA) at about 6,000 men, down from the peak of about 27,000 in the late 1980s.
It attributes the decline to the collapse of communism in Europe, disputes within rebel ranks, battlefield losses and defections.
